NBC live blog, updated 12:42 PM EST 2 Nov 2026. Trump to deliver closing argument at Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, "just to show how beautiful it is". No in-person rallies; tele-rallies instead. Trump approval 40% per NBC News polling. Final rally Salina, Kansas: "I'm closing the sucker down". Stevens: "I don't belong in Abdul's campaign". Vance rallies in Ohio and New York.
